title: tylophora dickinsii
intro: Tylophora dickinsii, commonly known as Indian ipecac, is a perennial plant species within the family Apocynaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and asthma, as well as for its anti-inflammatory properties. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-asthmatic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Tylophora dickinsii, including tylophorine and tylophorinine, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
